'''Outer Rim Construction and Assembly''' was one of the many companies owned by [[Cabra]], a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]]. One of their planned projects was the building of a [[Plasma Refinery Complex|refinery]] on a parkland, overlooking the [[Virdugo Plunge/Legends|Virdugo Plunge]] and the [[Theed Hangar/Legends|Theed Hangar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="DP" />
